text:
Aisha (CS): Heads-up — we have ~24 onboarding customers in EU/APAC seeing stalled VPC onboarding after the cert rotation yesterday. Need customer comms + RCA + localized templates. Can we get a short blameless note + remediation offer?
Diego (CS): ack. I can draft an english template. timeline?
Aisha (CS): goal = outbound within 2 hours. engineering ETA for fully automated retry is ~6-8 hours per Marco. we should offer manual enablement steps + temporary account-level workaround now.
Marco (Eng): confirming root cause: an intermediate CA in our cert chain expired and some onboarding agents rejected TLS handshake. rolling back intermediate to the previous chain fixes handshake; automated rollout will be done in ~6h. no customer data exposed.
Priya (AE): for renewal-risk accounts we should offer a 1:1 enablement session + 25% credit for the impacted day(s). propose variant in comms.
Lena (Localization): I can translate into fr/de/es/ja within 45 minutes. will need the final english copy.
Aisha (CS): Diego — please draft two variants: standard (all customers) + high-touch (priority renewals). keep concise, include steps to manually re-trigger onboarding, and link to status page. include apology and next steps.
Diego (CS): draft below — feedback pls:
```
Hi <Customer>,

We’re sorry — during a certificate rotation on our onboarding service, some customers using VPC onboarding experienced a failure to complete the connection. Our engineers identified an expired intermediate certificate that caused TLS handshakes to fail.

What we’re doing: we rolled back the intermediate cert to restore handshakes and are deploying an automated retry that will re-attempt the onboarding flows within the next 6–8 hours.

Short-term workaround: if you want to continue now, please follow these steps to manually re-trigger onboarding: 1) open your onboarding console > Connections > click "Retry"; 2) if you see TLS error, send the connection log to support@redwood.ai and we’ll assist within 2 hours.

Compensation: we’ll apply a one-time credit for the impacted hours. If you’re a priority account, your CSM will reach out to schedule a 1:1 enablement session.

We sincerely apologize for the disruption. Status updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2398765432

— Redwood Inference Support
```
Marco (Eng): technically accurate. add line: "no keys/data leaked" — important for auditors.
Diego (CS): added. updated draft posted to internal doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/rca-2398765432
Priya (AE): for high-touch variant add: "We’ve queued a prioritized onboarding retry for your tenant and a CSM will be in touch within 1 hour to confirm."
Aisha (CS): good. Lena — once translations done, we’ll send segmented outbound: EU/EMEA in local languages, APAC in EN/JA. Diego — include a short subject line and preheader.
Lena (Localization): translations in progress — will ping when ready.
incident-bot: Incident 2398765432 status changed: mitigation in progress — rolling rollback applied at 2398769032.
Diego (CS): subject suggestions: "Update: Onboarding connection issue — action taken" or shorter "Onboarding: connection issue resolved (next steps)". leaning toward second.
Aisha (CS): go with second. Diego — send out to all affected now with tags for priority accounts; Priya will follow high-touch replies. Track replies in the sprint backlog spreadsheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/ops/onboard-incident-2398765432
Priya (AE): will own scheduling and renewal risk flags. tagging CSMs for impacted accounts.
Aisha (CS): final checklist before send: 1) English + localized content ready, 2) subject/preheader set, 3) credits language confirmed, 4) status link & support email included, 5) tracking sheet open. thumbs if ready. :thumbsup:
